name: liftoff/code-group
title: CodeGroup
description: Themed tabbed code group built atop OriginTabs.

files.content:
---
/**
 * @title CodeGroup
 * @level liftoff
 * @description Themed tabbed code group built atop OriginTabs.
 * @category Documentation
 * @hydration optional
 * @accessibility
 * - Delegates tablist/tabpanel semantics and keyboard behavior to `OriginTabs`.
 * @keyboard
 * - Arrow keys move between code tabs; Enter/Space selects.
 * @slots
 * - `tabs`: `role="tab"` buttons.
 * - `panels`: `role="tabpanel"` code regions.
 */

import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types";
import OriginTabs from "@lsui/origin/Tabs.astro";
import "./docs.css";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof OriginTabs>;

---

<OriginTabs {...Astro.props}>
  <Fragment slot="tabs"><slot name="tabs" /></Fragment>
  <Fragment slot="panels"><slot name="panels" /></Fragment>
</OriginTabs>
